title: SpongeBob Fail
blurb: The SpongeBob fail sting — Bikini Bottom's dedicated sound for a plan collapsing in real time. The show's composers pulled heavily from vintage production-music libraries, including old Hawaiian and big-band recordings, which is why its stings sound simultaneously nostalgic and slightly unhinged. This one lands with just enough drama to make small disasters feel ceremonial. Use it when the attempt was sincere and the outcome was not — a gentler, sillier cousin of the sad trombone, and instantly recognisable to anyone raised on the show.
origin: A failure sting from SpongeBob SquarePants' legendary sound design.
